Jules (CS): FYI — SolaceAI demo in ~90min. They reported spikes from ap-northeast and eu-west; asked if we can add two CIDRs to allowlist and a brief burst for the demo.
Ava (AM): renewal discussion same week, outcome matters. please prioritize and note as demo-only.
Tariq (NetOps): need CIDRs + region list + burst size/duration. prefer auto-expire and a soft quota.
Jules (CS): CIDRs: 13.59.200.0/22, 45.77.11.64/26. Regions: ap-northeast-1, eu-west-1. Request: 120 req/min for 90m.
Tariq (NetOps): creating change CHG-5017, will tag "demo-temp" and set auto_revoke @ +95m. proposed rule pushed.
DeployBot: CHG-5017 scheduled to start in 8m, runbook attached.
Tariq (NetOps): applied to target pools. quick check: p95 latency dropped ~28% for demo traffic samples.
Ava (AM): great — I'll tell the customer and schedule a 20-min post-demo check-in to capture feedback and note in renewal playbook.
DeployBot: CHG-5017 auto-revoke executed at +98m; revoke successful, audit log recorded.
Jules (CS): revoke confirmed, baseline restored. follow-up call booked to capture demo feedback and UX/latency notes. Closing thread."
